'''Torrence Run''' was a location in [[Sector 18 (Arda I)|Sector 18]] of [[Arda I]]. It was named after [[Rik Torrence]], a skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who could fly through the dangerous landscape of Torrence Run, arguably better than anyone else in [[Vortex Squadron (Arda I)|Vortex Squadron]].<ref name="Onslaught" />
